headline: Last session: Sensex surged nearly 900 points and Nifty topped 22,500 as IT stocks led a sharp rebound.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: IT stocks jumped 3% and FMCG gained over 2%, leading a broad-based rebound across sectors.
All sectoral indices turned green on Friday as benchmark indices recovered from Thursday's steep sharp decline.
Strong gains in IT heavyweights like TCS lifted overall market sentiment on D-Street.
Nifty snapped its eight-week losing streak as buyers returned across benchmark stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex closed nearly 900 points higher, while Nifty50 comfortably settled above the 22,500 mark on Friday.
The Friday rally helped investors recover a significant portion of losses suffered during Thursday's market crash.
Elon Musk sparked discussions over India's satellite spectrum allocation by making comments directed at Reliance.
US markets posted weekly gains while gold and silver trading revenues hit record highs for US banks.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian equity markets staged a sharp rebound driven by strong gains in IT and FMCG stocks. Sensex surged nearly 900 points while Nifty reclaimed the 22,500 level, snapping an eight-week losing streak. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 12 October.
